verdict.reading: neither test clears at n=80: the skill stays suggestive and a much larger evaluation (or the fork-server) is needed

bug_found_and_fixed.symptom: the first attempt at the extension reproduced the first batch exactly: seed11 extension mean 78.7 with 1/10 survivals, identical to the first ten episodes
bug_found_and_fixed.cause: the evaluation runner did not pass --policy-seed, so both batches drew from the same torch RNG stream and sampled the SAME ten action sequences. Those 40 episodes were duplicates, not new samples
bug_found_and_fixed.why_it_matters: using them would have doubled the apparent sample size with copies and produced a fake n=80 significance result
fix: guard in the runner: abort if the new batch equals the first value-for-value
bug_found_and_fixed.scope: R37's n=40 is unaffected: those 40 episodes come from four DIFFERENT windows, so they are distinct even though each used policy-seed 0
bug_found_and_fixed.how_it_was_caught: the two batches reported exactly the same mean to one decimal

limitations: still one training run; this is a bigger evaluation, not a new seed of training
the four dev windows are the only ones in R28's frozen split, so n grows by repeating windows rather than by adding tapes
the distribution is bimodal (median below C-fair), so the mean is not a sufficient summary; both the mean and the survival rate are reported
